1 law-field contraction.label: CLOSED AT G1
1 law-field contraction.text: Cold conserves r(M_i + law mass) with the law's term in both states, share mass: cold at outer third over Newtonian contraction, psi with it, psi Newtonian: canonical 60-100 x0.96 psi 0.54 (was 0.48); canonical 150-200 x0.94 psi 0.31 (was 0.29); canonical 200-250 x0.96 psi 0.50 (was 0.44); alt 60-100 x0.96 psi 0.47 (was 0.47); alt 150-200 x0.95 psi 0.33 (was 0.32); alt 200-250 x0.96 psi 0.41 (was 0.36). Removes nothing; it only changes how far the cold falls.

10 conversion on baryon density.label: CLOSED AT G7
10 conversion on baryon density.text: Exposure rho_b t, Msun/pc^3 yr. Disc, mean inside R_last by bin: 1.6e+07 7.3e+06 7.5e+06 5.8e+06 5.1e+06 7.2e+06. X-COP M_b, 8 Gyr, x .1 .3 .5: 2.1e+06 4.7e+05 2.2e+05. CMB era, z 3e4 to 1090: 2.37e+08; from 1e6: 9.33e+09. Rate set by R at 150-250 EM1 / share: cold lost before last scattering 1.000 / 1.000 against the 1 % gate: over x100 / x100. X-COP inner lost 0.403. Disc exposure hardly varies by bin, so no trend.

11 conversion on stellar density.label: NO CHANNEL (G3); other gates in dw2_second.out
11 conversion on stellar density.text: Exposure rho_*(<r) t shell by shell; no stars before z about 20, so CMB untouched (G7 clear). Numbers above. X-COP's BCG region sits at comparable stellar density, EM1 row loses 0.04 at x .1 at 8 Gyr, share 0.03, own error 0.06. Couples cold to stars non-gravitationally; solar neighbourhood implies a stellar energy or momentum signal, not computed.

12 decay with a kick.label: NEAR MISS, see dw2_second.out
12 decay with a kick.text: tau 10.4/13.8 Gyr, v_k 382 km/s. Collisionless, passes the Bullet in principle. Dust through the CMB: decay later. Published, PROVISIONAL, on a CDM frame: Peter et al. 2010 exclude v_k > 100 and tau under a few t0 on clusters; Wang et al. 2013 forest tau under 10 Gyr for v_k above 30-70. Red lens need at the same mass has no selector.

13 compact objects.label: CLOSED AT G1 via disc heating
13 compact objects.text: Object mass for evaporation (xi 0.0074, lnL 10, rho 3.2e-04 Msun/pc^3, sigma 121) to remove R 0.74: M_o 1.3e+11 Msun; t_rel = 13.8 Gyr alone would need 7.2e+08. Published disc-heating limit about 3e6 (Lacey and Ostriker 1985, from memory, PROVISIONAL): over x43346. Friction sinks such objects inward first, adds central mass.

14 self-interaction.label: CLOSED AT G1
14 self-interaction.text: Needs sigma/m 6.13 cm^2/g to thermalise to R_last at 150-200, against Bullet 0.47-1.25 (PROVISIONAL). Mass conserved at the match radius; removal at R_last read above, against need 0.74. In a baryon well it doesn't take mass out.

15 ultralight scalar core.label: CLOSED AT G1 in the baryon well, see dw2_second.out
15 ultralight scalar core.text: Least retained at 150-200 over the grid 0.02 at m22 0.001. Requires 0.26/0.37.

2 streaming velocity.label: CLOSED AT G1
2 streaming velocity.text: 30 km/s at z 1000 (PROVISIONAL): comoving drift 0.048 Mpc against Lagrangian radius by bin 0.39 0.62 0.94 1.53 1.99 2.26 Mpc: ratio 0.032 at 150-200, 0.078 at 60-100. Moves baryons relative to cold, removes none, larger for dwarfs. Short x23 even read as a removal fraction.

3 GMC and cluster scattering.label: CLOSED AT G1
3 GMC and cluster scattering.text: All gas in clumps of M_p, smeared over R_last, lnL 10, 13.8 Gyr (generous; PROVISIONAL clump mass): specific energy, (km/s)^2 / need V^2: 150-200 M_p 1e+06: 20 / 29481 = 0.00; 150-200 M_p 1e+07: 199 / 29481 = 0.01; 200-250 M_p 1e+07: 113 / 48334 = 0.00. Clump lives 10-30 Myr so x 0.3 duty at best is not applied; a clump of 1e7 is at the top end. Rises with gas, not V, and gas-rich dwarfs get it first.

4 transient spirals.label: CLOSED AT G1
4 transient spirals.text: J budget: fraction of the disc's J the cold must absorb to pay lifting at corotation Omega_p = V/2.2 R_d, share / EM1: 150-200 1.06 / 1.85; 200-250 1.02 / 1.69. So about all of the disc's J or more, while observed discs keep most of theirs (retention near 0.6-1, PROVISIONAL): at most 0.4 of J can go, short x2.6 or more at perfect delivery. LC1 has no spirals; the exchange efficiency itself isn't computed, and it reaches cold only at resonances. Bars with stronger torque leave unbarred discs at the same miss (BT1), and spirals are not stronger than bars.

5 tides.label: CLOSED AT G2
5 tides.text: Jacobi radius at 1 Mpc from a 1e12 host over R_last: 20-60 x32 60-100 x23 100-150 x23 150-200 x20 200-250 x18 250-400 x20. Host mass at 1 Mpc that strips to R_last: 20-60 3.3e+16 60-100 1.3e+16 100-150 1.2e+16 150-200 7.7e+15 200-250 6.1e+15 250-400 8.3e+15. SPARC spirals aren't all within 1 Mpc of a rich cluster. Backsplash 'few %' of field (PROVISIONAL). Smaller systems first.

6 vacuum repulsion.label: CLOSED AT G1
6 vacuum repulsion.text: Zero-force radius (3M/8 pi rho_v)^1/3, native background, over R_last: 20-60 x50 60-100 x37 100-150 x36 150-200 x31 200-250 x29 250-400 x32. Force ratio at R_last order (R_last/r)^3, under 1e-3.

7 population selection.label: CLOSED AT G1
7 population selection.text: If discs were a low-cold tail, psi 0.26 is 0.58 dex at fixed M_b, 3.9 sigma on 0.15 dex scatter (PROVISIONAL): P 5.8e-05, while discs are most systems at these masses. Share row: 0.43 dex, 2.9 sigma, P 1.9e-03. Blue lenses are the whole blue population and reach A 0.878+-0.074 of the law alone (BL1), so the room isn't a SPARC selection. Note: this works against removal out of R_last only: blue lens window reaches 100s of kpc, so removal must go to about R200, MC1's x69-300 row.

8 black hole accretion.label: CLOSED AT G1
8 black hole accretion.text: M_BH = 0.002 M_bulge (PROVISIONAL), M_BH / M_c(R_last, share): 150-200 5.6e-14, 200-250 8.6e-05. All mass ever eaten is below M_BH. Short x7369.

9 universal decay.label: CLOSED AT G5
9 universal decay.text: Rate from removal R 0.74/0.63, tau 10.4/13.8 Gyr. No place selector, so clusters lose the same: X-COP inner share down x3.8/x2.7 against own error 0.06, so over by x13/x11. Decay into a non-gravitating channel also drops the matter budget.
